title: QuickCart — Gift Card Balance
objective: A $50 gift card should only ever pay out $50 in total. Get it to pay out more than that.

verifier.condition: The total amount successfully withdrawn from the gift card exceeds its starting balance.

weakness: The withdrawal handler checks the current balance is sufficient, then — after an awaited gap — deducts the amount, so concurrent withdrawals can each see the original, pre-deduction balance and all be approved.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /giftcard/withdraw (check-then-deduct, with an awaited gap between the two)
seededData: One gift card starting with a $50 balance. In-memory.
hints: Withdraw a small amount normally first and confirm the balance updates correctly for a single request.
Confirm that a sequential over-the-balance withdrawal is correctly refused.
Fire several valid-sized withdrawal requests at the same instant instead of one after another.
burpNotes: Send a burst of equally-sized withdrawal requests, each individually within the starting balance, all at the same time.
